# Archive fixture corpus

`corpus` contains immutable, small archives used by package-backed worker integration tests. `Generate-FormatFixtures.ps1` records exact source inputs and generator hashes without treating fixture passwords as user secrets.

The checked corpus was generated with official 7-Zip Extra 26.02 x64. Its archive SHA-256 is `081DF9E9311DFD9C9E0E98C1C80180B99BB51E4CB24156B5F3057FE3C259D70A`; the extracted `x64/7za.exe` SHA-256 is `35D4D69D7CD6CB44558F208C3B1334268013F9DAF82D2DDA848893A1C30C59C2`. The executable is not Authenticode-signed, so provenance rests on the official release URL plus these hashes. RAR fixtures are generated by the locally installed RAR 7.20 x64 command-line tool and are test inputs only; Rain Archives does not ship or invoke it.

The genuine `classic-split.z01` through `classic-split.zip` set is independently generated with the [DotNetZip 2025 upstream release tool](https://github.com/DinoChiesa/dotnetzip-2025/releases/tag/v2025.02.15), version 2025.2.3.0 from [commit `866343fa8508d120ebc4cb0f3a6cfe95b7e6987c`](https://github.com/DinoChiesa/dotnetzip-2025/tree/866343fa8508d120ebc4cb0f3a6cfe95b7e6987c). The release package SHA-256 is `9478CE160EBAFC33677A9FB0E5E16A6B4D5AFF50DCE5ACD9EA313FB2D4C8FD6E`; `dnzzip.exe` is `0665EF2A0DCE4E358C032567352EFB9A60B869BE7D23FFFD99B30441D16F557D`. Its exact [Apache-2.0 license](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DinoChiesa/dotnetzip-2025/866343fa8508d120ebc4cb0f3a6cfe95b7e6987c/LICENSE.txt) hashes to `69849221BFB90053DE2134EF5E6D540287B4B98062326492F1F96F5DA685524B`. DotNetZip is fixture-generation tooling only and is not a product dependency. Official 7-Zip must also test the completed set successfully during regeneration.

The password identifier is `fixture-password-v1`. The literal is held only in test/generator source, never in the fixture manifest, product command lines, protocol JSON, or operation logs. Encrypted archive bytes are intentionally not reproducible byte-for-byte because the generators use random salts and initialization vectors; their checked SHA-256 values are authoritative.

Generation refuses to overwrite an existing output directory. Example:

```powershell
.\tests\fixtures\Generate-FormatFixtures.ps1 `
  -OutputDirectory .\tests\fixtures\corpus `
  -SevenZipPath "$env:TEMP\RainArchives.Tooling\7zip-26.02\expanded\x64\7za.exe" `
  -DotNetZipPath "$env:TEMP\RainArchives.DotNetZipFixtureTool\expanded\dnzzip.exe" `
  -RarPath "C:\Program Files\WinRAR\Rar.exe"
```
